status_summary: The FY2026 National Defense Authorization Act, Public Law 119-60 of 2025-12-18, includes section 1631, Adjustment to responsibilities of Nuclear Weapons Council. Per a code compilation, the section makes the Council the primary mechanism for integrating nuclear deterrence activities across DOD and DOE and widens its oversight and plan and budget review roles, in line with the Mandate's call to refocus the Council. No review of the three weapons laboratories' non-security portfolios, or of Navy, Homeland Security and Maritime Administration nuclear construction programs by the Director of Naval Reactors, was found. A CRS report of 2026-07-14 puts the FY2027 Naval Reactors request at $2.39 billion, 12 percent above the FY2026 enacted level.

timeline.event: The FY2026 National Defense Authorization Act (S. 1071) became Public Law 119-60; its section 1631 adjusts the responsibilities of the Nuclear Weapons Council in 10 U.S.C. 179, making it the primary mechanism for integrating nuclear deterrence activities and expanding its oversight and plan and budget review roles.

title: Review NNSA lab non-security work, the Nuclear Weapons Council and nuclear construction

A truncated table of contents is not evidence that other provisions on laboratories or Naval Reactors are absent; the NNSA sections (3101 onward) were not read.
